run_fit_normalizers_cli: run the fit_normalizers CLI script with a config yaml to compute dataset mean and std
run_fit_norms_with_linref: run fit_norms with a config and linear reference file to fit normalizers with element references
fit_normalizers_from_config: fit dataset normalizers from a config by loading the training dataset and computing mean and std
save_normalizers_checkpoint: save fitted normalizers to a checkpoint file named normalizers.pt at the specified output path
load_config_and_fit: load a config yaml file and fit normalizers using the training dataset transforms configuration
